Introduction
Welcome to the Perceptyx developer portal. You’ll find comprehensive guides and documentation to help you start working with the Perceptyx API as quickly as possible.
The Perceptyx API is a REST-based API, employs OAuth 2.0, and allows you to communicate or query our system using a simple URL syntax.
Communicating with the Perceptyx API can be thought of as a sequence of requests. You can request information to be sent to Perceptyx, updated, removed, or returned to your system. These requests can be made by either GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE requests, which return JSON responses.
📘
To use our API, please visit our Customer Care Portal.
How To Get Started
To effectively interact with the APIs, consider employing tools such as Postman or cURL. While your eventual goal would be to integrate these API calls within your codebase, these tools offer a straightforward starting point. Notably, as you amass a collection of API calls within Postman, it can also generate foundational code snippets for each request, streamlining your development process.
Identifying Your API URL
To direct a request to a particular endpoint, it's imperative to determine the region where your Perceptyx instance is stationed—either in the US or the EU. The structured format for the URL is as follows:
https://api.{region}.perceptyx.io/v1/RequestPath
Herein, {region} represents the primary region of your Perceptyx instance based on your geographical location, while RequestPath denotes the specific API endpoint's path.
Examples using the Surveys API in the US/EU region would look like:
USEU
https://api.us.perceptyx.io/v1/surveys/listhttps://api.eu.perceptyx.io/v1/surveys/list
You can find which region you need from the main login URL you use or by visiting our Customer Care Portal.
